description: This file defines the 'Duration' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling duration formats in spreadsheets. It extends DateTimeWizard and provides constants and methods for formatting durations with various options such as hours, minutes, and seconds, including variations for leading zeros and durations exceeding standard limits.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Handles formatting of durations in spreadsheet styling, supporting various duration formats and separators, extending DateTimeWizard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Duration object with separators and format blocks, defaulting to standard duration formats if none are provided.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps input format blocks to their correct format, transforming duration codes to lowercase, and wrapping literals.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the combined duration format string, concatenating format blocks with separators.
